pullRequest.title: Weekly Gift Aid claim
pullRequest.body:
Adds `bin/giftaid.mjs`, which prints the week's Gift Aid claim for the treasurer: each declared donor whose goods sold, their proceeds and the claim, then the totals.

We claim 25p for every £1 raised from a declared donor's goods, so £40.00 of proceeds is £10.00 of Gift Aid. Only donated goods count, and only from the day the donor's declaration was made: Tom Baptiste's lamp sold the day before he signed, so it isn't claimed.

A donor only counts as declared once their declaration is recorded in `data/donors.json`. The treasurer adds it there from the signed form; this report never guesses.
pullRequest.author: sam
